r.경제 체제: Market economy · tourism, cars, food, renewable energy
r.주식시장 시가총액: $1.3 trillion, 68% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)
r.빅맥지수: $7.08 for a Big Mac, $0.86 more than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist, euro-area average)
r.생활 물가 수준: 69% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Cars 14%, Machinery, computers 7%, Electronics, electrical equipment 6%, Pharmaceuticals 5%, Refined petroleum 5% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 39%, Plastics 10%, Electronics, electrical equipment 7%, Machinery, computers 7% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Pork 16%, Gold, precious metals, gems 9%, Animal and vegetable oils 8%, Pharmaceuticals 5% (2025, share of value)
r.한국과 맺은 FTA: Korea-EU FTA (provisionally applied 2011, fully in force 2015)
r.정치 구도: A constitutional monarchy and parliamentary system; Catalan independence is a major political issue.

t.why: Deeply connected with Spanish-speaking Latin America, it is the EU's fourth-largest economy.
t.rel: Across the sea from Morocco, migration and territorial issues are intertwined, and it holds Ceuta and Melilla on the African side. British Gibraltar is a long-standing issue too.
t.know: It is divided into 17 autonomous communities, and some also use Catalan, Basque or Galician as official languages.
t.etext: A tourism giant strong in cars, food and renewable energy. It sells a lot of olive oil, fruit and vegetables to Europe. High unemployment, especially among young people, is a long-standing problem.
